{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh
#FLUX -J M1_build
#FLUX -o  ./stdout/M1_build.o{id}.out
#FLUX -e  ./stdout/M1_build.e{id}.error
#FLUX --time=2d  # 2 days

#FLUX -N 1
#FLUX -n 1 # used for MPI codes, otherwise leave at '1'
# NOTE: Flux does not have a --mem-per-cpu option. Since cpus-per-task defaults
# to 1, this is equivalent to --mem-per-task.
#FLUX --mem-per-task=16G  # memory per core; default is 1GB/core

## send mail to this address, alert at start, end and abortion of execution

# does not have a direct equivalent for job status email notifications.

START=$(date)
echo "Started running at $START."

unset DISPLAY
## mpirun nrniv -mpi MC_main_small_forBeta_shortburstensamble.hoc #srun
python build_network.py #srun

END=$(date)
echo "Done running simulation at $END"
"
}
